label: Higher at D2 after choosing a1, and whenever the observer believes S1 is good.
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase != D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (prev_reward == 1)
explanation: Raw reset gate r26 is mostly timing (high at GO, low at D1/D2; timing R^2 0.93). Beyond timing, its main graded driver is at D2: it is higher after the agent just chose a1 (observed as the action input at D2) and rises with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good; a smaller positive belief_lo effect holds at D1 and GO too. The state reached at D2 adds little once the choice is known. The free fit adds: at D1 and GO it rises after an unrewarded previous trial (most after a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u), at D1 it rises after the previous trial reached S1, and the D2 a1 effect is stronger when the previous trial was rewarded. No future variables used.

issues: Every claim checks out on test. Short form 0.663. Swapping the global belief_lo term for (phase != D2)*belief_lo gives the same 0.663. Dropping the global belief_lo gives 0.612, so the belief effect outside D2 is real but small (fitted weight +0.009, against +0.032 in total at D2). Using state instead of action at D2 gives 0.632, and adding state alongside action gives 0.606, so the choice beats the state reached, as claimed.

The label says 'whenever the observer believes S1 is good', which undersells how phase-specific the belief effect is. At D2 the belief-decile residual runs from -0.13 to +0.16; at D1 and GO it runs only from -0.03 to +0.03. The label should say the belief effect is concentrated at D2.

A systematic error class remains in misses. D1 after a1 S1 u is under-predicted by +0.100 and D1 after a2 S1 u by +0.089. D2 after S2 trials is over-predicted: a2 S2 u by -0.096, a1 S2 u by -0.073, a1 S2 r by -0.071. The worst windows are long unrewarded streaks, where the actual D1 value is about 0.36-0.42 and the prediction about 0.10. The explanation text mentions this, but it is not in the label or short form.

Replacing the third term with a no-reward term did not raise test R^2. The variants tried, with test R^2: (phase==D1)*(prev_reward==0)*(prev_state==1) 0.657; (phase!=D2)*(prev_reward==0) 0.660; a two-trial no-reward streak at D1 0.629, or at D1 and GO 0.633; (prev_reward==0)*(prev_state==1) 0.630. So the error class cannot be captured within 3 terms, and the recorded short form is the best one I found.
skeptic.revised_label: Higher at D2 after choosing a1 and with belief S1 is good; weak belief effect elsewhere.

final_label: Higher at D2 after choosing a1 and with belief S1 is good; weak belief effect elsewhere.
